BRICS seeks Gulf peace amid regional tensions

The BRICS bloc is actively pursuing peace initiatives in the Gulf region amidst growing regional anxieties and ongoing conflicts. The group aims to foster stability and bridge divides among Gulf nations. This diplomatic push occurs as concerns about wider regional wars intensify. The BRICS nations are engaging in dialogue to de-escalate tensions and promote cooperation.
